name: apple-calendar
description: Reads Apple Calendar on a Mac for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: unanswered invites, pending replies to your invites, and meetings that need preparation. Read only, enforced by a guard on every other tool.

before_tool.command: echo 'apple-calendar is read only: only list_calendars, list_events, list_events_quick, search_events, check_conflicts and find_duplicate_events may be called. Do not retry or look for another way to change a calendar.' >&2; exit 2

waiting-on-me.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me skill to find what is waiting on me on Apple Calendar.

waiting-on-them.prompt: Use the waiting-on-them skill to find what I am waiting on others for on Apple Calendar.

action-now.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-now: what I need to act on today on Apple Calendar.

action-soon.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-soon: what I need to act on soon on Apple Calendar.

catch-up.prompt: Use the catch-up skill to catch me up on one conversation, thread or topic on Apple Calendar: where it stands, what happened and what is open. Take the subject from the caller; if none is given, ask for one.

find.prompt: Use the find skill to find what the caller asks for on Apple Calendar (something someone said, a number, an address, a plan) and name where and when. Take the search from the caller; if none is given, ask for one.

all.prompt: Answer all four triage questions on Apple Calendar, following triage-report: action-now, action-soon, waiting-on-them, then the counts.
